statements.statement: The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient reports persistent episodes of palpitations that interfere with daily activities
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered for extended ambulatory assessment
The service was to characterize the arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
